rationale.conceptual: Implementing the RPA for a binary mixture, performing crystal energy minimization over a grid, and extracting phase boundaries via common-tangent construction requires understanding of liquid-state theory and DFT. The algorithms are described in the paper and are non-trivial but not research-novel beyond the paper's own derivations.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has several sequential stages (λ-line root-finding, crystal minimization as a process step, coexistence curve, Lindemann ratios). The crystal minimization feeds into two scored outputs, creating dependencies, but overall the orchestration uses only numpy/scipy and standard JSON I/O, without external data fetching.

The method is established but multi-part and needs careful numerical implementation. Execution involves a pipeline of several steps with dependencies but standard libraries and straightforward I/O.
